monthlyRevenueRub.description: Average monthly project revenue over the last 6 months.

weeklyHours.description: Current total weekly owner involvement across client work, content, sales, team and operations. Used for capacity/owner-dependency analysis; not an automatic score modifier.

monthlyRevenueRub.description: Manager-agreed stable monthly revenue required for the client's desired net earnings. AI does not convert profit to revenue.

delegation.description: What the client wants to keep personally and what to transfer to people/AI. Primary input for desired owner role and Founder–Model Fit.

desiredSystemWeeklyHours.description: Conditional. Desired weekly workload after the system is built, only when time freedom/reduced owner involvement is explicitly part of the goal. Otherwise null.

struggles.description: Client-perceived gap from current state to goal: what is not working, why the client thinks growth is blocked, how long it repeats, and what they believe may help. Treat as hypothesis/self-report, not diagnosis.

bestPeriod.description: Best historical period: actual result/metrics, what worked differently, and which mechanism may be repeatable. Historical evidence unless current operation is confirmed.

failures.description: History of attempted growth solutions: what was tried, actual result, where the break occurred, client explanation, investments if relevant, and what they do not want to repeat. Used as historical evidence, repeated-break pattern, solution history and report context.
